label: Area
definition: FAOSTAT name of the reporting geographic area
allowed_values: Botswana; Eswatini; Lesotho; Malawi; Mozambique; Namibia; South Africa; Zambia; Zimbabwe
notes: The teaching extract omits provider area codes; use codes rather than labels when integrating other sources.

label: Item
definition: FAOSTAT classification identifying the highest available government level used for SDG indicator 2.a.1
notes: The actual government level is retained in note and can vary across countries and years.

label: Element
definition: FAOSTAT indicator represented by the value field
allowed_values: SDG 2.a.1: Agriculture share of Government Expenditure
notes: This is the numerator component of the Agriculture Orientation Index rather than the composite index.

label: Year
definition: Calendar year to which the expenditure share refers
missing_values: years without provider observations are absent
notes: Eight countries have complete teaching-period coverage; Zimbabwe has observations for 2009-2012 only.

label: Unit
notes: Values are percentage shares rather than proportions between zero and one.

label: Value
definition: Share of total government expenditure allocated to agriculture forestry fishing and hunting at the highest available government level
missing_values: blank represents missing and is not zero
notes: The broad COFOG-based category is not maize-specific and does not measure expenditure effectiveness.

label: Flag
definition: FAOSTAT status describing the origin or treatment of the reported value
notes: The tracked sample contains estimated values; definitions are recorded in metadata/faostat-flag-code-list.csv.

label: Government level
definition: Highest government level represented by the observation
allowed_values: Budgetary Central Government; consolidated General Government
notes: Changes in government level can affect comparability over time.
